claim: For fiscal Q4 2025, Apple disclosed $416.2 billion in revenue.
summary: Apple's fiscal Q4 2025 (September quarter) revenue was about $102.5B, not $416.2B; $416.2B is approximately Apple's full-year FY2025 revenue. Attributing the annual total to Q4 is false.

sub_claims.text: Apple disclosed financial results for fiscal Q4 2025.
sub_claims.note: From general knowledge Apple reports a fiscal Q4 ending in September, including Q4 2025 reported in Oct 2025.

sub_claims.text: Apple's revenue for fiscal Q4 2025 was $416.2 billion.
sub_claims.note: Quarterly revenue scale is ~100B; Q4 FY2025 was ~102.5B in billions USD. 416.2 matches full-year FY2025 scale, not a single quarter, so quarterly attribution is false by factor of ~4x.
